🚨Delhi Health Authorities Issue HMPV Advisory 🚨

#Delhi's #Health department has issued an advisory to prepare for  #HMPV after rising respiratory cases in China.

Hospitals must report Influenza-like ILI & Severe Acute Respiratory Infection (SARI). Strict protocols enforced.
